# Nailed it by Sarah

> Professional nail studio in Gan Yavne, Israel, run by Sarah M.
> Specialises in gel manicures, anatomic nail builds, gel fills, French manicure, and hand-painted nail art.
> Founded 2020 · 5.0★ on Google · serves clients across central Israel (Gan Yavne, Yavne, Ashdod, Rehovot).

## Business facts

- **Name:** Nailed it by Sarah (Hebrew: Nailed it by Sarah, also referred to as "נייל איט בי שרה")
- **Owner / artist:** Sarah M — nail technician and freelance nail artist. Originally from Spain, raised in London, settled in Gan Yavne after getting married. Trained as a visual artist; treats each nail as a canvas.
- **Languages spoken by Sarah (fluent):** Hebrew, English, French, Spanish. Communicates with clients in all four; tourists welcome.
- **Website:** https://nailed-it-by-sarah.vercel.app/
- **Website languages:** Hebrew (default), English, French, Spanish, Arabic.

- **Parking:** Free street parking on Ha-Atsma'ut Street and adjacent side streets.

## Services and prices (in ILS, all-inclusive)

### Treatments
- **Basic Manicure — ₪80.** Cuticle work, shaping, buff and polish on the natural nail.
- **Gel Manicure (with gel polish) — ₪100.** Full manicure finished with cured gel polish. Lasts 3–4 weeks.
- **Anatomic Build — ₪130.** Sculpted gel reinforcement that adds length and shape with a strong, ergonomic apex.
- **Gel Fill — ₪150.** Maintenance on an existing build; gel is added to the regrowth area at the cuticle. Recommended every 3–4 weeks.
- **New Build — ₪250.** Full set built from natural nails with no previous base.

### Add-ons
- **Touch-ups — ₪5 to ₪10** (per spot)
- **French / Pearl Powder — +₪20** on top of any manicure
- **Design on one nail — ₪5 to ₪10**
- **Simple design on all nails — ₪50**

### Removal
- **Removal — ₪50.** Professional, gentle removal of gel polish or build.
- **Removal + Manicure — ₪80.** Removal followed by a fresh basic manicure.

## Frequently asked questions

**How much does a gel manicure cost in Gan Yavne?**
A gel manicure at Nailed it by Sarah costs ₪100. A basic manicure is ₪80. Book via WhatsApp at 053-272-7006.

**How long does a gel manicure last?**
Properly applied gel lasts 3 to 4 weeks without chipping. With an anatomic build you can extend up to 5 weeks by getting a gel fill.

**What are the opening hours?**
Sunday to Thursday, 09:00 to 21:00. Closed Friday and Saturday.

**How do I book an appointment?**
Booking is by WhatsApp on +972-53-272-7006 or by direct message on Instagram @nailed_it_by.sarah. There is no online booking form.

**Do you take walk-ins?**
No. The studio is by appointment only.

**Where exactly is the studio?**
Ha-Atsma'ut Street 1, Gan Yavne, Israel. Free street parking is available.

**What languages does Sarah speak?**
Hebrew, English, French and Spanish — all fluently. Message her in your preferred language.

**Do you serve clients from Yavne, Ashdod, Rehovot?**
Yes. Clients regularly travel from Yavne, Ashdod, Rehovot, Rishon LeZion and elsewhere in central Israel.

**Are kids welcome?**
Children's nail services are offered on request. Mention age when booking on WhatsApp.

**Is there a cancellation fee?**
No fee for cancellations made at least 24 hours in advance. Repeat no-shows may affect future bookings.

**What's an anatomic build vs a new build vs a fill?**
- *Anatomic build* (₪130) — sculpted reinforcement on a natural nail, adding shape and a strong apex.
- *New build* (₪250) — full set built from scratch on natural nails.
- *Fill* (₪150) — maintenance every 3–4 weeks on an existing build.

**Do you do French manicure?**
Yes. French manicure or pearl powder finish is +₪20 on top of any manicure.

**Can I see Sarah's work before booking?**
Yes — the gallery on the website and her Instagram (@nailed_it_by.sarah) show recent work.

## What makes Sarah's studio different

- **Multilingual technician.** Sarah is fluent in Hebrew, English, French, Spanish, and conversational in Arabic — one of very few nail technicians in central Israel who can host an entire appointment in any of these languages. Tourists and new immigrants do not have to settle for broken communication.
- **Intimate, owner-operated studio.** No chain salon, no rotating staff. Every appointment is with Sarah herself, in a calm, private setting — not a noisy walk-in counter.
- **Small client list = personal attention.** Sarah deliberately keeps her schedule manageable, which means longer slots, no rushed work, and a true relationship between technician and client.
- **Anatomic build specialist.** Anatomic gel builds — sculpted, ergonomic and strong — are a core specialty, not an upsell. Many clients come specifically for the structural quality of Sarah's builds.
- **Hand-painted nail art at an honest price.** Detailed nail art is ₪5–₪10 per nail or ₪50 for a full set — a fraction of what comparable studios charge in Tel Aviv. Sarah's background in painting and design shows in every set.
- **Tourists welcome.** Visitors to Israel can message in their own language on WhatsApp, schedule a single visit, and pay in cash, card or Bit.
- **Family-friendly atmosphere.** Kids' nail services are available on request — handy for families visiting from abroad or local mums booking a treat for their daughters.
